reply.emotion: warm and appetizing, sitting down for a good meal
notes: Used to mean both the meat we eat and the physical flesh of a body.

senses.definition: Parte muscular del cuerpo de los animales que se usa como alimento.

examples.text: Compramos carne fresca para la cena de hoy.
examples.translation: We bought fresh meat for dinner today.
examples.emotion: hungry and looking forward to a nice meal

senses.definition: Parte blanda del cuerpo de los seres vivos, bajo la piel.

examples.text: Sintió el frío en su propia carne.
examples.translation: He felt the cold in his own flesh.
examples.emotion: shivering and feeling a sudden chill

senses.definition: Parte interior y blanda de las frutas.

examples.text: Esta fruta tiene una carne muy dulce y jugosa.
examples.translation: This fruit has very sweet and juicy pulp.
examples.emotion: delighted by something sweet and refreshing
